purpose: Reader-facing labels for the seven-page local Desktop report and current reporting fields. Keep machine fields, measure names and export schemas unchanged; semantic expressions are maintained in the model contract.

sources.sba: U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) approval records
sources.census: Census Business Dynamics Statistics (BDS): employer business locations
sources.bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), Local Area Unemployment Statistics (LAUS)

total_approved_loan_amount.label: Reported approval amounts ($)
total_approved_loan_amount.tooltip: Nominal whole-loan amounts for 7(a), plus the SBA/Certified Development Company portion of 504. Not disbursements or total financing.

loan_count.label: Approval records
loan_count.tooltip: Public approval records with mapped project geography and calendar dates. Includes canceled/not-funded records; not unique borrowers.

approval_amount_coverage_count.label: Records with known approval amounts
approval_amount_coverage_count.tooltip: Valid amounts including zero. Unknown amounts remain in approval-record totals but are excluded from the average denominator.

state_name.label: Project location (state / DC)
state_name.tooltip: Project location reported on the approval record: 50 states and Washington, DC. This is separate from borrower headquarters.

approval_year.label: Calendar approval year
approval_year.tooltip: Year of the approval date, separate from the SBA fiscal year.

year.label: Calendar year
year.tooltip: Shared year label; source observation windows still differ.

loan_program_name.label: SBA program
loan_program_name.tooltip: 7(a) and 504 have different reported amount bases.

naics_sector_name.label: Industry sector
naics_sector_name.tooltip: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) grouping. Unknown/unclassified sectors remain in total activity and are excluded from known-sector shares.

lender_name.label: Reporting lender name
lender_name.tooltip: Currently assigned bank for 7(a); reported third-party lender for 504. Normalized names are not resolved historical originators or banking groups.

establishment_count.label: Employer business locations
establishment_count.tooltip: Census employer establishments across firm sizes; excludes nonemployers. Annual reference stocks summed across years are establishment-years.

bds_reference_date.label: Census business-count reference date
bds_reference_date.tooltip: March 12 of the reference year; context for calendar-year lending, not an identical time window.

freshness_checked_at_utc.label: Publication and download checks evaluated at (UTC)
freshness_checked_at_utc.tooltip: Frozen evaluation time. Opening the report later does not update release evidence or download checks.

latest_extracted_at_utc.label: Source files downloaded at (UTC)
latest_extracted_at_utc.tooltip: When the saved public data was extracted; separate from observation date and modeled-table rebuild.

latest_observation_date.label: Source-wide latest reference date
latest_observation_date.tooltip: Latest cutoff across the source system: approval date for SBA, March 12 annual reference for Census, and month end for BLS. SBA historical resource segments repeat the source-wide cutoff; it is not each file's own latest approval date.

extract_age_days.label: Days since source download
extract_age_days.tooltip: Age at the stated UTC check time, compared with the configured extraction tolerance.

observation_age_days.label: Days since source observation/reference
observation_age_days.tooltip: Descriptive age of the source reference. This is not a stale-data rule and does not measure publication or download age.

snapshot_validity_status.label: Saved input validation
snapshot_validity_status.tooltip: Passing source checks establish usable saved evidence, independently of age.

freshness_status.label: Source recency
freshness_status.tooltip: Stale means a verified newer published period is missing. Expired publisher or download checks require verification; old reference dates alone are not stale.

raw_load_status.label: Source loading status
raw_load_status.tooltip: Whether raw inputs were loaded; this is not final pipeline completion.

latest_run_status.label: Final completion visible in reporting tables
latest_run_status.tooltip: Unknown during the same build. Actual completion comes from the separately dated final pipeline summary.

observed_month_count.label: Months with unemployment data
observed_month_count.tooltip: Available non-null monthly state rates; compare with expected/publisher-omitted months.

publisher_omitted_month_count.label: Months not published
publisher_omitted_month_count.tooltip: Publisher omissions are disclosed separately from unexpected missing data.

is_comparable_context.label: Complete economic context
is_comparable_context.tooltip: A complete lending year with same-year positive business counts and comparable monthly labor coverage.

unemployment_rate_yoy_change_pp.label: Unemployment change (percentage points)
unemployment_rate_yoy_change_pp.tooltip: 4% to 5% is +1 percentage point; only comparable annual periods support a change.

publication_reference_date.label: Latest verified published reference period
publication_reference_date.tooltip: Quarter-end coverage for SBA; March 12 of the BDS reference year; month end for BLS. Compare at each source cadence.

publication_date.label: Published on
publication_date.tooltip: Actual publication date from publisher evidence. Unknown dates stay blank; coverage cutoffs and catalog modified dates are not publication dates.

publication_verified_date.label: Publisher checked on
publication_verified_date.tooltip: Date on which the latest published period was verified. This is separate from the release and download dates.

publication_source_url.label: Publisher evidence
publication_source_url.tooltip: Official source used to verify the reference period and any known publication date.

publication_cadence.label: Publication frequency
publication_cadence.tooltip: Expected release frequency, separate from reference-year lag. Frequency does not prove a new release exists.

next_scheduled_release_date.label: Next announced release
next_scheduled_release_date.tooltip: Confirmed publisher schedule when available; a schedule passing triggers verification, not an assumed new release.

publication_status.label: Published-period comparison
publication_status.tooltip: Saved source period compared with dated publisher evidence.

download_status.label: Download review
download_status.tooltip: A local review window for the saved download; review due does not prove a newer release exists.

freshness_reason.label: Recency assessment
freshness_reason.tooltip: Specific reason for the publication or download status; show this beside the dates.

max_release_check_age_days.label: Publisher review window (days)
max_release_check_age_days.tooltip: Local limit on the age of publication verification, not a publisher deadline.

release_check_age_days.label: Days since publisher verification
release_check_age_days.tooltip: Age of the dated publisher check at the frozen evaluation time.

pages.title: Lending at a glance
pages.question: How much approval activity is there, and how has it changed?
pages.narration: Start with reported amounts, record count, average known amount and full-year change. More dollars do not necessarily mean more records. Label the partial October–December 1990 and January–June 2026 periods; do not compare them with full annual totals.

pages.title: How lending varies by state
pages.question: Where are reported amounts and approval records largest?
pages.narration: Compare the ten leading states within the selected calendar year and geography. The history chart retains complete calendar years independently of the year slicer; blank growth means the selected periods or state populations are not comparable.

pages.title: Reporting lender names
pages.question: How much activity is assigned to the largest known names?
pages.narration: Show the ten leading names after adding amounts across the selected geography and years. Known-name coverage and the selection-wide top-five share retain all names, independently of the lender slicer and displayed ranking.

pages.title: Programs and industries
pages.question: What makes up the reported lending total?
pages.narration: Show program shares of all reported amounts and industry shares of known-sector amounts in separate panels. Category selections affect their selected-category cards while distribution charts retain the full mix. The ten-sector amount ranking includes unknowns where present; known-sector coverage explains the share denominator.

pages.title: Lending relative to local businesses
pages.question: How does activity compare with the employer business base?
pages.narration: Use complete lending years with same-year employer locations. Single-year intensity is records per 1,000 locations; several years use establishment-years. Restrict this view to comparable context; economic rates are on the separate single-state conditions page.

pages.title: Local business conditions
pages.question: What economic conditions surround lending in one state?
pages.narration: Start with California in 2023. Show the state's mean monthly seasonally adjusted unemployment rate, change in percentage points, and published business entry and exit rates. Cards require one state and one year; history charts retain that state's available years. This matched-context view ends in 2023, even though the separate labor source has newer observations.

pages.title: Source coverage and data checks
pages.question: What periods do these inputs cover, and can they be trusted?
pages.narration: Show source-wide reference periods, actual publication dates, download dates and publisher verification. Historical SBA resource segments repeat the source-wide cutoff. Distinguish a missed published period from verification due; show validity and separately dated final completion independently.

status_labels.success: Completed successfully (use separately dated final summary)

source_publication_timing.sba: Quarterly; typically one month after quarter end.
source_publication_timing.census: Annual; typically September, about two years after the reference year.
source_publication_timing.bls: Monthly; use the dated state release and its announced next release.
